item.title: Breaking News: Officer Involved Shooting in Conroe
item.description: 4:15 p.m. Moments ago, medics transported a suspect with a gunshot wound from Carl Barton Jr. Park to an area hospital. The Montgomery County Precinct 2 Constable’s Office was reportedly involved. The park is located at 2500 S. Loop 336. Additional information will be posted as it becomes available.

item.title: CONROE DEPUTY INVOLVED SHOOTING
item.description: At 3:15 pm, a Montgomery County Precinct 2 Deputy stopped a truck on Loop 336 South near Carl Barton Park. The driver pulled into the park and exited the vehicle.
